answer: Sealed-bid admission auction blocks fakes: one newcomer seals one bid for a cedar plot into a ferrous bid-box, with a bridge record of real work. Top bids win plots; winners lock 70 credit as bond. Auditors replay the box: one key bidding twice, or a fake bridge record, burns the bond. First bid 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 vs 40,000 pool. Rented bridge records fail: one job, one key. Honest: one bid, 40 once, full share.
